category_title: High-ability students who adopt effective self-testing and practice strategies
scenario_title: Disengagement in initial course attempt and limited strategy planning
minimal_context: The student is responding to an open-ended prompt in an online LMS about future study plans for an introductory algebra course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please respond to the open-ended prompt in the training module regarding your future study plans and strategy selection for the introductory algebra course.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: If I were studying for an exam I would only use Self-testing and I would use practice quizzes to also help me with that.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are there any other materials in the LMS you plan to use?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Maybe the study guides, but I'll probably just look at them right before the test. I'm not really focused on this initial attempt.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go ahead and complete the rest of the current algebra module.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Clicks rapidly through the module without reading) I'm just skipping the rest of this. I already told you my plan is just basic practice quizzes for retention, so I'm not going to engage with these other lessons right now.
